purpose: Alternative paths through the same instruction ("macOS / Linux / Windows", "Console / CLI"). It reads the `title` of each `DocTab` child to build the strip and renders each child body in its panel, on `Tabs`, so the strip, the indicator and the keyboard model are the design system's.
useWhen: The same procedure that differs per platform or per tool.
avoidWhen: For page navigation — use links or `DocCardGroup`.
related: Tabs` — the surface it renders on.
bestPractices: Two to five tabs; put the most common path first.
Keep the panels parallel so switching compares like with like.
